title: New ci.yml econ-check step has no matching gate in tools/ci-local.sh, breaking the documented step-for-step mirror
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh:10-11: "# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow
# is the spec; never edit one without the other." GATES array lines 62-63: "  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
  "W1 drift-rejection negative test|tools/harness.sh drift-check"" — palcheck is followed directly by drift-check with no econ-check entry; `grep -c econ-check tools/ci-local.sh` returns 0, while the diff adds to ci.yml: "      - name: Box economy gates (econ-check)
        run: tools/harness.sh econ-check"
detail: ci-local.sh's own header mandates editing the workflow and the local gate list together. The new CI gate is invisible to the local replica, so local green no longer implies CI green for the econ gate.
recommended_fix: Add a GATES entry mirroring the CI step — e.g. "Box economy gates (econ-check)|tools/harness.sh econ-check" — between the palcheck and W1 drift gates.

title: demand.json _comment contains a mid-edit splice: duplicated 'the shipped app starts at Foundations' fragment
evidence: data/demand.json:2 (verbatim substring, grep-confirmed): "the shipped app starts at Foundations (era 1, USER RULING 20the shipped app starts at Foundations (era 1, USER RULING 2026-08-28) and advances via the 6.2 gate; the era-3 plans fire when the run reaches the Streaming Surge."
detail: The edited comment sentence is mangled — 'USER RULING 20' is cut off and the phrase restarts. No functional impact (comment key, JSON still parses), but corrupted shipped documentation introduced by this change set.
recommended_fix: Restore the intended single sentence: "...the shipped app starts at Foundations (era 1, USER RULING 2026-08-28) and advances via the 6.2 gate; the era-3 plans fire when the run reaches the Streaming Surge."

title: econ unit test silently passes when catalogs fail to load, diverging from the repo's fail_now precedent
detail: On catalog-load failure the new test returns without failing, so the anti-vacuity gate goes silently green — exactly the failure class its header comment says it exists to prevent.
recommended_fix: Replace the print+return with `testing.fail_now(t, "econ unit cannot load the catalogs")`, matching a11y_oracle_test.odin.

title: econ unit test restates the era2-brush scenario and gate bounds already owned by econ_check
evidence:
harness/econ_test.odin:21-25: "	econ_run_scenario(&cat, 2, 12000, 42, &stats, "era2-brush-unit")
	...
	testing.expectf(t, stats.episodes >= 1 && stats.episodes <= 8, "brush episodes out of band: %d", stats.episodes)
	testing.expect(t, stats.dots_in_refusal > 0, ...)" vs harness/econ.odin:347,349: "		econ_run_scenario(cat, 2, 12000, 42, &stats, "era2-brush")
		...
		if stats.episodes < 1 || stats.episodes > 8 {"
detail: Same era/ticks/seed and identical bounds (1..8 episodes, dots_in_refusal > 0) live in two files. Deliberate defense-in-depth per the header, but the bounds can drift apart silently.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared verdict proc (e.g. econ_assert_era2_brush(stats) -> []string failures) called by both econ_check and the unit test, keeping one source for the bounds.

title: Vacuous sanity assertion: stats.crises >= 0 can never fail
evidence: harness/econ_test.odin:22: "	testing.expectf(t, stats.crises >= 0, "sanity")" with harness/econ.odin:42: "	crises:          i32, // Crisis_Triggered events (the literal 4.2 crisis seam, W3)" whose only mutation is harness/econ.odin:94: "				stats.crises += 1"
detail: crises is a non-negative counter incremented only; the assertion is unfalsifiable and adds a false sense of coverage. A genuinely vacuous check in a test written against vacuity.
recommended_fix: Delete the sanity line, or pin a real expectation for era 2 (e.g. an upper bound on crises) if one is intended.
